tools.name: wallet_status
tools.description: Status of the DogeUni wallet agent session: when it expires and which paired agent this server is. Read-only.

tools.name: get_agent_account
tools.description: Address of the wallet's dedicated agent account (never the user's main accounts). Read-only.

tools.name: get_agent_balance
tools.description: Balance of the agent account. `amount` is DOGE as a decimal string. Read-only.

tools.name: quote_fee
tools.description: Network fee the wallet would charge to send `amount` DOGE from the agent account to `to`. Does not spend. `fee` and `feePerKb` are DOGE decimal strings.

amount.description: Amount in DOGE as a decimal string, at most 8 decimals, e.g. "12.5".

tools.name: prepare_send
tools.description: Build (but do not sign or send) a DOGE send from the agent account. Does not spend. Returns a `prepareId` for submit_send, valid until `expiresAt` (5 minutes) and usable once. `policy` is a preview of what submit_send will do under the grant the user set in the wallet: ALLOW = sends without asking, ESCALATE = the user will be asked to approve, DENY = will be refused. `reasons` lists why. Recipients and limits are set by the user in the wallet; the agent cannot change them.

amount.description: Amount in DOGE as a decimal string, at most 8 decimals, e.g. "12.5".

tools.name: submit_send
tools.description: Sign and broadcast a send made by prepare_send. Spends real DOGE, from the agent account only. The wallet re-checks the user's grant: within it, the send goes out at once; otherwise the user is asked in the wallet and this call may wait up to 5 minutes for their answer. On BROADCAST_FAILED the transaction may still have gone out: do not retry without checking the chain.
